cause_quote: The worker-read change added `context.getRuntimeConfig() !== cfg` to the guard after the awaited session read, then returned any resulting exception through `respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, formatErrorMessage(error)))`.
user_saw: The New Session project picker could show an internal error and ask the user to retry when project data changed during loading.
summary: The fix retries the entire project listing up to three times when a consistency check detects a mid-read change and returns a plain retryable error if all three attempts fail.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #152691 and confirmed that the existing default listing read recents synchronously after the registry lookup and returned them without a config check across a session-read await. #152691 introduced that await and made a config change during it fail the request immediately. #154705 later added the session-projection guard and the specific wording reported in the picker, extending the same fail-on-change behavior.
